study.title: CVFSNet: A Cross View Fusion Scoring Network for end-to-end mTICI scoring

imaging.modality_detail: Dual-view (coronal and sagittal) DSA sequences from mechanical thrombectomy procedures
imaging.territory_detail: Cerebral; M1 segment of the middle cerebral artery occlusion/stenosis, anterior circulation sequences in acute ischemic stroke
imaging.frames_per_sequence: 5 to 76 frames; uniformly resampled to 8 frames for input

data_released.detail: AmTICIS dataset (411 dual-view DSA sequence pairs) stated as publicly released via https://github.com/xwjBupt/CVFSNet; data availability statement says data available on request

annotation.annotator_expertise: Two physicians with 4 years of experience and a chief physician with 20 years of experience (15 years stated in Discussion); double-blind scoring, chief physician adjudicated disagreements
annotation.inter_rater_value: Cohen's kappa between physicians A and B = 0.408 (fair); A-C and B-C moderate

task.task_description: End-to-end automatic 5-class mTICI reperfusion scoring (T0/1, T2a, T2b, T3 after merging T0 and T1) from dual-view DSA sequences, plus dichotomized good/bad reperfusion (mTICI >= 2b) classification.
task.clinical_application: Assessment of reperfusion success after mechanical thrombectomy for acute ischemic stroke

temporal_evidence.quote: To capture hierarchical information within the DSA sequence and model blood flow velocity variations, we integrated the 3D convolutional network X3D (Feichtenhofer, 2020) as the backbone of our network.

method.class_imbalance_handling: MARC margin calibration in the linear layer; Label smoothing loss and Seesaw loss

code_available.detail: Code and data will be available at https://github.com/xwjBupt/CVFSNet

G1.quote: Currently, the absence of a publicly available mTICI scoring dataset based on dual-view DSA sequences impedes the progress of automatic mTICI scoring research.

G2.quote: the sample size of AmTICIS can be further expanded by incorporating data from multiple centers to enhance its diversity.

G3.quote: They decouple the spatiotemporal features, extracting spatial features first and then temporal features, which may lose the inter-frame spatiotemporal characteristics in the DSA sequence.

G4.quote: As DSA images represent projections, blood vessels may overlap at a single viewing angle, making it challenging to distinguish individual vessels accurately.

G5.quote: improving annotation consistency and reducing observer bias could benefit from involving more annotators, inviting more experienced annotators, or adopting a more standardized annotation protocol.

G9.quote: In order to alleviate the majority class domination effect caused by the category imbalance, we used MARC (Wang et al., 2023) in the linear layer to calibrate the margins

other_limitations: Dataset only includes M1 segment occlusions, limiting clinical applicability
Compared video classification methods support only single-view input, possibly disadvantaging them
Only three physicians annotated due to time, manpower and financial constraints
Temporal depth limited to 8 frames partly due to computational resources
future_work: Expand dataset to other occlusion locations (ICA, BA, ACA, PCA)
Incorporate multi-center data to increase sample size and diversity
Involve more or more experienced annotators and a standardized annotation protocol
